about_the_game:
Open World Souls-Like

Dreamspring is a dark fantasy styled, open world, souls-like, dungeon crawler game. As a spellsword gunslinger, you'll explore ethereal landscapes shrouded in twilight, battle fearsome creatures, and uncover ancient secrets. Explore the dying Kingdom of Mortis and its different realms in first person action combat, in a world mixed with retro and vaporwave aesthetics.

With inspiration from Morrowind and King's Field, Dreamspring aims to be an open world dungeon crawler similar to those games, but it still succeeds in having a unique take on the genre. The open world and story take elements from the real world in a distant doomed future, plagued by a mysterious legend, the Dreamsprings. Balance is aimed to be on the easier end, as a less punishing type of Souls/Scrolls-like game.

The Story

The Kingdom of Mortis, a realm in ruins, looms beneath a twilight sky. The once strong empire has become barren and desolate and the few remaining people are haunted by nightmares and despair. Only the Holy City floating above is the last remnant of civilization, ruled by a religious army. Tormented by dreams of an unwanted visitor, one solitary figure dares to venture into the heart of the dying world in an attempt to uncover its secrets and restore balance to the realm, a desperate attempt to save the waking world from certain doom.
